description: Voice ID consent: grant and withdraw, with erasure on withdrawal.

cases.inputs: actorId: a user without consent; noticeVersion: "1.5".
cases.return: Success with the voice profile showing the new consent (MSG305 "Đã bật nhận diện giọng nói cho tài khoản của bạn.").
cases.log: Saved: consent row with notice 1.5 and its purpose; audit row records the grant.

preconditions: User consented to notice "1.2" and keeps voice samples.
cases.inputs: actorId: a user consented to "1.2"; noticeVersion: "1.5".
cases.return: Success (MSG305); the consent is renewed in place to 1.5 and the samples stay.
cases.log: Saved: consent notice renewed; audit row records the renewal with the old and new versions.

cases.return: Failure Invalid (MSG313); errors[noticeVersion] = ["Nội dung thông báo đã thay đổi. Hãy tải lại trang và đọc lại trước khi đồng ý."]; nothing is stored.
